dataMode.title: Data saver
dataMode.intro: Set a budget and the player picks the best quality that fits it, down to audio only.
dataMode.toggleHint: Sharing with other viewers stays off while this is on. Your choice is kept on this device.
dataMode.budget.label: Budget
dataMode.budget.audio: Audio only, about {mb} MB an hour
dataMode.budget.low: Low video, about {mb} MB an hour
dataMode.budget.medium: Medium video, about {mb} MB an hour
dataMode.suggested: Your browser asked to save data, so the audio-only budget is selected. Turn the switch on to use it.
dataMode.usage.rate: Data used: {used} this session, about {rate} MB an hour
dataMode.usage.unknown: This browser does not report what the stream downloads.
dataMode.estimate.video: At this budget the stream uses about {mb} MB an hour.
dataMode.estimate.audio: At this budget the stream plays audio only, about {mb} MB an hour.
dataMode.overBudget: Audio only is the lowest this stream goes and uses more than your budget. It plays anyway, and the meter shows what it really uses.
dataMode.notice.nativeReload: On this device a budget change reloads the stream, with a short pause.
dataMode.notice.dvr: Data saver does not apply while you watch behind live.
dataMode.notice.vod: Data saver does not apply to videos.
